pattern.description: A large, blurred V4 wordmark sharpens while a gradient pill outline closes in around it from beyond the frame edges, then the whole lockup shrinks to a small centred badge.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous move turns a full-screen title into a compact product badge: blur-to-sharp focus pull, the outline wrapping the mark, and a decisive scale-down give it a crafted, lens-like feel instead of a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.fromTo('.v4-text', {filter:'blur(12px)'}, {filter:'blur(0px)', duration:0.4, ease:'power2.out'}); simultaneously gsap.fromTo('.v4-pill', {scale:3.2}, {scale:1, duration:0.8, ease:'power3.inOut'}); then gsap.to('.v4-lockup', {scale:0.15, duration:0.35, ease:'power4.in'}) as the pill finishes. Pill stroke uses a conic/linear gradient.
build_hint.remotion: Drive pill scale with interpolate(frame, [0, 24], [3.2, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}) and text blur with interpolate(frame, [0, 12], [12, 0]); then a lockup scale from 1 to 0.15 over frames 24-34 via spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 180}) (no overshoot).

notes: camera.move reports pull_out; it reads as the lockup scaling down rather than a true camera move, since the background is flat. Corner boxes b03-b06 are the pill stroke exiting the frame edges, not separate elements.
